title: Sales By Customer link, PDF and CSV work as before the release
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Before the release was installed, you saved Sales By Customer's PDF and CSV for {Date-A} with one location ticked, and copied a link to Sales By Customer with that filter.
    For example: {Date-A} is the day before the release.
  • Starting screen: the release is installed; Reports (top menu; its left menu lists the A/R reports under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE and the A/P reports under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the Sales By Customer link saved before the release.
  2. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Open the PDF and compare it with the saved PDF.
  4. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  5. Open the CSV and compare it with the saved CSV.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: Sales By Customer opens with the same filter ticked as before.
  • Step 2: the PDF downloads.
  • Step 3: the same rows, amounts and layout as the saved PDF.
  • Step 4: the CSV downloads.
  • Step 5: the same rows, amounts and layout as the saved CSV.

Why: the reports reuse the native chips, totals row and export of these three reports, so a change made for the aging reports could reach them (Rule 96, shared component).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

From: Developer verify task SV-11597 "A/R & A/P aging — verify Phase 1: shared report kit" (updated 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Jira SV-11597, Check: “Inventory Value, Sales By Customer and Work In Progress: filters, links shared from the address bar, and CSV/PDF exports behave exactly as before.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 2 "Export" (board Export.dc.html); page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). The design draws no picture of this behaviour (all 7 boards and 45 figures checked); the case follows the PRD.
